name: Perfect Valentine
source:
Valentines Day is approaching yet again and just like every other year you're still single. You decide to download a dating app in hopes that you're able to get a date for Valentine's Day when suddenly you're transported to a place where you meet two mysterious men. One of them even claims to be Cupid himself!

[From [url=https://madizzy-studios.itch.io/valentines-day-game]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一年一度的情人节又要到了，而你一如既往还是单身。你决定下载一款交友软件，希望能赶在情人节找到约会对象，谁知竟突如其来地被传送到了一个陌生的地方，在那里邂逅了两名神秘男子——其中一人甚至自称就是丘比特本人！

[摘自[url=https://madizzy-studios.itch.io/valentines-day-game]itch.io[/url]]
